blocked_by: FE-2 #43 merged (it is in the fe-5 branch)
goal:
Show free first paints and happy hour on the wall. Spec: docs/payments/2026-11-01-paid-board-revision-spec.md §F1 and §F2. Settings and their meaning: docs/payments/board-settings-reference.html (Free painting section).

START FROM: main once PR #42 is merged; until then branch from claude/gifted-knuth-bm5wrf-fe-5 (contains FE-0, FE-1, FE-2, FE-4, FE-5). Code lives in web/src/pages/wall/ (controllers: pricing-controller.ts owns credits and quotes; wall-view.ts owns status text; paint-controller.ts sends paints).

CONTRACT VIEWS (exact, on main in contracts/paid-board/src/free_paint.rs):
- get_free_first_paints({account_id}) -> {used: u32, remaining: u32, active: bool, allowance: u32, registered: bool}. active = first board not yet full and allowance > 0.
- get_happy_hour({account_id?}) -> {open, enabled, first_fill_complete: bool, window_start_ns, window_end_ns: U64 strings, used, cap, remaining: u32, eligible: bool, requires_purchase: bool}. When closed, the window shown is the NEXT one.
- get_stroke_cost({account_id?, cells:[{x,y}]}) -> {costs: u32[], free: bool[], total: u32}. FE-2 already calls this from pricing-controller; reuse its result, do not add a second quote call.

SCOPE
- Dock line: 'N free paints left' while free first paints are active and the account is registered; if not registered, say that registering (0.01 NEAR) unlocks 25 free paints.
- Stroke total: mark free cells as free (e.g. '3 cells · 1 free · 2 credits'), using get_stroke_cost.free.
- Happy-hour banner on the wall: hidden while the first board is filling; when closed, countdown to the next window shown in the viewer's local time with the UTC time in brackets; when open, time left and 'N free cells left for you'; when used up, say so; when not eligible because requires_purchase and the account never bought, say 'buy credits once to join happy hour'.
- One plain line each for the rules: base-price cells only (recently painted cells still cost 2 or 4), up to 100 per person, only after the first board is full.
- Refresh both views after every paint and every minute while the page is visible.

ACCEPTANCE (tests that fail before)
- stroke total with free cells; dock line states (active / unregistered / ended)
- banner states: filling, closed with countdown, open, used up, not eligible
- local-time display from window_start_ns (test with a fixed timezone)
- Playwright screenshots at 390 px and 1280 px for: free paints active, happy hour open, happy hour closed (mock mode), paths in the PR.


WORKING RULES (read twice)
- Do exactly the scope. Do not delete or rename existing methods, files or tests unless the scope says so; if something looks wrong outside scope, write it in the PR description instead.
- New work does not need to support the old board3 contract (owner, 2 Nov): a fresh testnet board will be deployed.
- One branch, one PR to main. PRs do not edit docs/backlog.md: put the status change in the PR description (AGENT.md).
- CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) must be green.
